intro: Catalogues, technical data, certificates and installation guides. Everything here is a PDF and everything is current — superseded editions are removed rather than left to be downloaded by mistake.
note: Need something that is not here, or an edition in another language? Ask the technical desk.

categories.name: Catalogues
categories.blurb: The full range, by product family. Sections drawn to scale with ordering codes.

items.title: Profile Systems Catalogue 2026
items.blurb: Every window, door and partition system with sections at 1:1, glazing ranges, hardware schedules and ordering codes.

items.title: Facade Systems Catalogue 2026
items.blurb: Unitised and stick systems, panels, cassettes and louvres, with typical details and test data.

items.title: Furniture Profiles Catalogue
items.blurb: Handles, frames, wardrobe track, LED channel and plinth, with finish options per section.

items.title: Honeycomb Panels Catalogue
items.blurb: Core specifications, bonded panel build-ups and the standard applications for each.

items.title: Catalogue Hệ Nhôm Định Hình
items.blurb: Phiên bản tiếng Việt của catalogue hệ profile, đầy đủ mặt cắt và mã đặt hàng.

categories.name: Technical data
categories.blurb: Performance figures, alloy data and the tolerances we actually hold.

items.title: Alloy and Temper Data Sheet
items.blurb: Mechanical properties for 6060, 6063, 6061, 6082 and 7003 across the tempers we supply, with typical extrusion tolerances.

items.title: Thermal Performance Guide
items.blurb: Uf values by system and glazing build-up, calculated to ISO 10077-2, with the condensation risk assessment method.

items.title: Structural Sizing Tables
items.blurb: Span tables for mullions and transoms by wind load, and the deflection limits they are based on.

items.title: Finish Specification Guide
items.blurb: Anodising and coating classes, film thickness, pretreatment and how to write a finish into a specification.

items.title: Extrusion Tolerance Standard
items.blurb: What we hold on wall thickness, straightness, twist and cut length, against EN 12020-2.

categories.name: Certificates
categories.blurb: Current certification for the plants and the lines. Reissued annually.

items.title: ISO 9001:2015 Certificate
items.blurb: Quality management, all five plants. Issued by the certification body named on the document.

items.title: ISO 14001:2015 Certificate
items.blurb: Environmental management, all five plants.

items.title: IATF 16949 Certificate
items.blurb: Automotive quality management, covering the Binh Duong automotive line only.

items.title: QUALICOAT Class 2 Licence
items.blurb: Powder coating licence for the vertical line, with the approved powder systems listed.

items.title: QUALANOD Licence
items.blurb: Anodising licence covering both lines, including the 25 µm marine process.

items.title: AAMA 2604 and 2605 Test Reports
items.blurb: Third-party weathering, adhesion and chemical resistance results for the powder and PVDF systems.

categories.name: Installation
categories.blurb: For the people fitting it. Written to be used on site, not read at a desk.

items.title: Window and Door Installation Guide
items.blurb: Setting out, fixing centres, packing, sealing and the drainage checks to make before the finishes go on.

items.title: Unitised Facade Installation Manual
items.blurb: Bracket setting, crane handling, stack joint engagement and the sequence for closing a bay.

items.title: Cassette Cladding Fixing Guide
items.blurb: Rail carrier setting out, cassette hook engagement and removal without disturbing the neighbours.

items.title: Care and Maintenance
items.blurb: Cleaning intervals by exposure, what not to use on an anodised surface, and what the warranty requires you to record.

items.title: Hướng Dẫn Lắp Đặt Cửa
items.blurb: Bản tiếng Việt của hướng dẫn lắp đặt cửa sổ và cửa đi, dùng trực tiếp tại công trường.

categories.name: Corporate
categories.blurb: Company reporting and the documents procurement departments ask for.

items.title: Company Profile 2026
items.blurb: Plants, capacity, markets and capability, in the form usually wanted for a prequalification pack.

items.title: Sustainability Report 2025
items.blurb: Recycled content, energy, water and waste, with the figures that did not improve reported alongside those that did.

items.title: General Conditions of Sale
items.blurb: Standard terms for export orders, including incoterms, tolerance on quantity and the claims procedure.

items.title: Warranty Terms
items.blurb: What is covered, for how long, by finish family and exposure, and what voids it.
